risks.note: The BRSR reports manufacturing and assembling of automotive components as 99.19% of turnover with exports contributing only 2.58% of total turnover, so nearly all revenue is tied to one activity and to Indian OEM demand; revenues are largely business-to-business to OEM customers as a tier 1 supplier.
risks.risk: Single-activity concentration on the automotive OEM cycle, overwhelmingly domestic

risks.note: Identified by the Company as a material issue: manufacturing activities involve operational hazards that may lead to injuries, production disruption and legal liabilities, with negative impact stated as medical expenses, compensation cost, production loss, legal liability and reputational damage. Mitigation is a stronger safety culture, KY activities, machine safeguarding, safety patrols, behaviour-based safety, training and audits.

Flagged as a material risk that may lead to accidents, injuries and production interruptions; mitigation is interlocks, guarding improvements, emergency stop systems, residual pressure control and safety automation, which itself carries investment and maintenance cost.

Listed as a material issue — standard of work may suffer on the exit of experienced employees, high turnover disrupts workflow and decreases productivity, and there is a high cost associated with recruiting, hiring and training replacements. Permanent worker turnover was 12.28% and permanent employee turnover 6.87% in FY 2025-26, both improved from 17.50% and 8.77% in FY 2024-25. Mitigation is robust succession planning for all critical roles and structured induction.

Contractor activities may introduce safety hazards, accidents and compliance issues, with accident liabilities, project delays and reputational impact as the stated downside; mitigated through contractor induction, permit systems, supervision, competency evaluation and audits.

Fire incidents may occur due to oils, electrical systems and hot work activities, with asset damage, downtime and insurance costs as the stated impact; mitigation is emergency drills, fire detection systems, hot work permits, firefighting training and regular inspections.

Non-compliance with environmental, safety and labour regulations may result in penalties, legal actions and operational disruptions, including shutdown risk; mitigation is periodic compliance evaluations, internal audits, statutory monitoring, legal updates and training. The Board's Report separately notes the Company has a detailed Risk Management Policy that the Board periodically reviews.
risks.risk: Regulatory compliance with safety, health and environment laws

risks.note: Rising energy costs and carbon regulations may increase operating costs; dependence on conventional energy sources adds carbon and regulatory pressure; water scarcity and stricter regulations may affect operations and increase costs; and improper handling or disposal of hazardous waste may cause environmental pollution and non-compliance with disposal costs, penalties and environmental liabilities.
